what:
system-actions concurrency group displaces PENDING runs: a queued system-action is cancelled when the next one is dispatched (GitHub keeps one pending run per group). Observed 2026-11-06: #23563 mark-operator-flattened 4935 cancelled before running (re-filed #23604); #23606 gateway swap-status cancelled before running; pull-exchange-funding 42136833028 cancelled. With the hosted-runner backlog (system-action jobs queued 5-75 min), any two dispatches inside the queue window lose the first silently, and only a '[RUN cancelled]' page shows it. Fix candidates: a per-action concurrency group key (action+target) with cancel-in-progress false, or a queue/retry in the relay; never silently drop a mutation request.

[2026-11-12 BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261112] ROUTE: Same mechanism (the system-actions concurrency group drops a pending run), and that row owns the fix.
